noInherit.description: If true, the annotation is not inherited by mixins.

env.description: If specified, all function requests to the type will be dispatched to this environment.

app.description: If specified, all function requests to the type will be dispatched to this application.

cluster.description: If specified, all function requests to this type will be dispatched to this cluster.

fetchTags.description:
Ordered list of apps to search for fetch/get operations.  Entries can be "." for current app; ".<app>" for app in
current env or "<env>.<app>".  Not valid to specify if {link: env}/{link: app}/{link: cluster} is
specified.  Note that the evaluate function may not be called on a type if more than one app is specified.

writeTag.description:
Tag to write data into during upsert operations.  It's structure matches those define in {@link fetchTags}.  Only
valid if {@link fetchTags} is specified and the specified app matches one of the apps specified there.
